# @(#)quiet / org / reports/src/setup.org / 2026-10-24

# Shared export settings for quiet reports.  Each report includes this file
# with #+SETUPFILE.  Tables come from reports/data and are generated by
# `quiet report`; never edit them by hand.

#+LANGUAGE: en
#+OPTIONS: toc:nil num:t author:nil ^:nil
#+LATEX_COMPILER: lualatex
#+LATEX_CLASS: article
#+LATEX_CLASS_OPTIONS: [10pt,a4paper]
#+LATEX_HEADER: \usepackage[margin=2.2cm]{geometry}
#+LATEX_HEADER: \usepackage{fontspec}
#+LATEX_HEADER: \setmainfont{Libertinus Serif}
#+LATEX_HEADER: \setmonofont{Libertinus Mono}
#+LATEX_HEADER: \usepackage{xcolor}
#+LATEX_HEADER: \usepackage{booktabs}
#+LATEX_HEADER: \newcommand{\swatch}[1]{\fcolorbox[HTML]{9AA29C}{#1}{\rule{0pt}{0.7em}\rule{1.4em}{0pt}}}
